Kevin's

up

and

and
green
spaces

spotless

up

Near

areas
,

group

.

identify

and

for
removal
,
effectively
completing
the
task
of
checking
for
and

ecosystem
.
Karen's
team

meanwhile

will
handle

and
repainting
tasks
,
working
to

.

appearance

also

,
thus

renewing
paint
on

.
